title: Add Docling PDF extraction acceptance

context.summary: Prove PDF native and scanned extraction through the real Docling profile.
context.background: Docling must produce durable derived artifacts and searchable source refs, not just pass a service smoke test.

in: Add native and scanned PDF fixtures for Docling extraction.
Persist page artifacts, OCR spans, chunks, embeddings and search source refs.
Handle failed and retry states for Docling extraction jobs.
Add live or integration acceptance against the real Docling service.

acceptance_criteria: Native PDF extraction through Docling creates searchable page-backed artifacts.
Scanned PDF OCR through Docling creates searchable OCR spans.
Docling failures surface readable job errors and are retryable.
PDF search results include document and page source refs.

manual_checks: Confirm raw PDF objects remain immutable.
Confirm Docling-derived state can be recomputed.

risks: OCR output can vary by Docling version and must be tested through stable assertions.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
